def parse_grid(input_str):

# Transform: horizontal 8-segments bounded by 4/6 on both ends -> all 2
def transform(grid):
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        c = 0
        while c < len(grid[r]):
            if grid[r][c] == 8:
                start = c
                while c < len(grid[r]) and grid[r][c] == 8:
                    c += 1
                end = c - 1
                length = end - start + 1
                left = grid[r][start-1] if start > 0 else None
                right = grid[r][end+1] if end+1 < len(grid[r]) else None
                
                if length >= 2 and left in [4, 6] and right in [4, 6]:

                        result[r][col] = 2
